[[To Alexander Macmillan](../persons.html#939)]I send herewith the other tale, Selma’s Secret Sighs in a Christmas number[^2]

C M Yonge

[^1]: Postcard addressed to \'A Macmillan Esq/ 30 Bedford Street/ Covent Garden/ London E C.\' and postmarked Winchester, 11 July 1879.

[^2]: CMY was assembling the stories which were republished as [Bye-Words](../books.html#135) (1880).
